HEARTH & CRUMB

FLOUR. WATER. A LITTLE PATIENCE.

 

Good mornings start here.

 

The ovens are warm. The counter is full. Your weekend ritual is waiting.

This weekend’s little pleasures

 

We give our dough a long rest, so you can take the morning slowly. Pick up your favourites while the crust is still singing.

 

01 / The everyday loaf

 

A deeply golden sourdough with a soft, open crumb. Made for butter, soup and second slices.

 

02 / A very good croissant

 

Layer upon layer of cultured butter. Best enjoyed with absolutely no plans.

 

03 / Pear & almond tart

 

Soft orchard pears, frangipane and a crisp shell. Just the right finish to a long lunch.

Something sweet to take home.

 

Our pear and almond tart comes in generous slices. Add a little cream. Share if you like.
